plugins.gcloud: Google Cloud console APIs: projects, service enablement, API keys, billing, monitoring, storage, BigQuery and IAM, plus the rest of the infrastructure, data, devops, networking, security and governance APIs.

plugins.gsearch: Public search and web-quality APIs (Custom Search, PageSpeed, CrUX, Safe Browsing, Web Risk, Fact Check) that take an API key instead of OAuth. The Custom Search JSON API is closed to new customers and is scheduled to be discontinued on 2027-01-01.

plugins.gmail: Gmail mailboxes, messages, labels and settings, plus Gmail Postmaster Tools.
plugins.gcalendar: Google Calendar calendars, events and calendar settings.
plugins.gchat: Google Chat spaces, messages and members, plus Workspace Events subscriptions.
plugins.gmeet: Google Meet spaces, conference records, participants and recordings.
plugins.gcontacts: Google Contacts and People, personal health metrics, Data Portability, and the OAuth2 userinfo endpoints.
plugins.gtasks: Google Tasks task lists and tasks, plus Google Keep notes.
plugins.gclassroom: Google Classroom courses, coursework, submissions, students and teachers.
plugins.gapps: Apps Script projects and execution, plus the Workspace Marketplace SDK.
plugins.gadmin: Google Workspace administration: Cloud Identity, Chrome management and policy, Groups Settings, licensing, reports, alerts, Vault, reseller and Cloud Search admin.
plugins.ganalytics: Google Analytics admin and data APIs for GA4 properties, configuration and reports.
plugins.gtm: Google Tag Manager accounts, containers, tags, triggers and variables.
plugins.gyoutube: YouTube Data, YouTube Analytics and YouTube Reporting APIs, plus Blogger.
plugins.gbusiness: Business Profile accounts, locations, verifications, lodging, place actions, notifications and performance.
plugins.gads: Google Ads API (accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, budgets, conversions, assets and GAQL reporting, with every other method through the gateway), plus advertising and publisher APIs: Search Ads 360, Display & Video 360, Campaign Manager, Ad Exchange, AdSense, AdMob, Real-time Bidding and more.
plugins.gmerchant: Merchant Center: Merchant API and Comparison Shopping Service, through a service account key.
plugins.gplay: Google Play developer publishing and reporting, Play Games Services, Android Enterprise and Management, Play Integrity and device APIs.
plugins.gfirebase: Firebase management, App Check, App Distribution, Crashlytics, Hosting, Data Connect, Rules, Test Lab, FCM and Identity Toolkit.
plugins.gmaps: Maps Platform and location APIs: Places, Address Validation, Solar, Air Quality, Pollen, Street View Publish and related datasets.
plugins.gai: Generative and classic AI APIs: Discovery Engine, Vertex AI, Dialogflow, Vision, Speech, Translate, Document AI and agent services.

groups.cloud: Application Default Credentials or an OAuth user token with the cloud-platform scope
groups.workspace-user: OAuth user token for Gmail, Drive, Calendar and the other personal Workspace APIs
groups.workspace-admin: Service account with domain-wide delegation, impersonating a super admin
groups.service-account: Service account key for Google Play and Merchant Center (no user login)
groups.searchconsole: OAuth user token with the webmasters scope
groups.business: OAuth user token with the scopes of the business APIs
groups.developer: OAuth user token with the scopes of the developer platform APIs
groups.apikey: API key for public APIs that take no sign-in (set with setup-apikey)

servers.name: gcloud

storage.source: Discovery, storage v1: maxResults "The service will use this parameter or 1,000 items, whichever is smaller"
storage.reason: Google's default page is far over the 25,000-character result limit, so the answer would be cut and Google's nextPageToken would skip what was cut. Sizes are estimates from Google's resource schemas, not measured on live data.

storage.objects.list.reason: An object's metadata (links, hashes, size, times, storage class) is about 0.7 KB; 1,000 are about 28 times the limit.

storage.buckets.list.reason: A bucket's metadata (location, IAM configuration, lifecycle, soft delete policy) is about 1 KB; 1,000 are about 40 times the limit.

drive.reason: Google: "For all methods of the about, approvals, comments (excluding delete), and replies (excluding delete) resources, you must set the fields parameter. These methods don't return a default set of fields." The descriptions of about.get, approvals.list and the comments methods say the same. * returns every field; the fields argument narrows it.

admin.source: Discovery, admin reports_v1: maxResults "Determines how many activity records are shown on each response page"; default 1000, maximum 1000
admin.reason: Google's default page is far over the 25,000-character result limit, so the answer would be cut and Google's nextPageToken would skip what was cut. Sizes are estimates from Google's resource schemas, not measured on live data.

reports.activities.list.reason: Each record is one event (actor, IP address, the events and their parameters), about 0.5 to 1 KB of compact JSON; 1,000 are 20 to 40 times the limit.

reports.userUsageReport.get.reason: One report per user; without the parameters filter a report holds every application's parameters, several KB, so 1,000 are megabytes.

reports.entityUsageReports.get.reason: One report per entity; without the parameters filter a report holds every parameter of the entity type, several KB, so 1,000 are megabytes.

cloudsearch.reason: Google's default page is far over the 25,000-character result limit. Sizes are estimates from Google's resource schemas, not measured on live data.

cloudsearch.settings.datasources.list.reason: A data source with its indexing service accounts, operation ids and item names is about 0.5 to 1 KB; 1,000 are 20 to 40 times the limit.

places.reason: Google: "If you omit the field mask, the method returns an error." There is no default list of fields. These defaults ask only for fields of the Essentials, IDs Only and Pro SKUs, plus nextPageToken for text search paging; Enterprise fields (rating, phone numbers, opening hours, website, price level) cost more and are asked for by name in field_mask.
